scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm --workspace @multi-rate/shared run build && npm --workspace @multi-rate/api run build && npm --workspace @multi-rate/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @multi-rate/shared run build && npm --workspace @multi-rate/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace @multi-rate/api run typecheck && npm --workspace @multi-rate/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace @multi-rate/shared run test && npm --workspace @multi-rate/api run test && npm --workspace @multi-rate/web run test
